summary: Project statuses: Waiting, Running, Successful, Failed, Error (update could not run), Canceled, Never updated, OK (manual project in place) and Missing (not in /var/lib/awx/projects); Manual projects cannot schedule SCM updates.
questions: What does project status Missing mean?
What is the difference between Failed and Error for a project?
Why can't I schedule an update for a manual project?
What does project status OK mean?
